# HUGINN v0.1 campaign plan (HUG-OPS-003, Phase 7)

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_campaign.py from defs/campaign.yaml and the pinned
     orbit. Do not edit. The classification is computed, not scheduled by hand. -->

Four passes: one nominal and three exercising a different fault each. Each names
the procedure to follow, the contact to fly it on, and what to watch for.

## D-014 — the inputs, read from the record

| Quantity | Value | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| Elevation mask | 10° | defs/orbit/ground_station.yaml contact_model.elevation_mask_deg (CONOPS Sec. 3.3) |
| Acquisition overhead | 120 s | PROC-001 step timings: PROC-001-S06 at AOS + 2 min is the last step before the commanding window opens |
| Close-out reserve | 120 s | PROC-001 step timings: PROC-001-S15 at LOS - 2 min, which commanding may not run into |
| Smallest schedulable activity | 10 s | Dictionary Sec. 2: no counter delta within 10 s of a verified send is the loss-of-commandability threshold; PROC-001-S12's unacknowledged branch is that same 10 s |
| Margin for one retry | ×2 | D-014's own clause, 'with margin for one retry'; PROC-003-S14 is the retry ('Retry once within the pass') |
| Housekeeping frame period | 1 s | defs/tlm_cmd.yaml housekeeping rate_hz: 1 (Dictionary Sec. 1, nominal 1 Hz housekeeping frame) |

## The arithmetic

```
overhead        = acquisition 120 s + close-out 120 s = 240 s
activity needed = 10 s x 2 (one retry)      = 20 s

USABLE FOR COMMANDING  iff  (time above mask - 240 s) >= 20 s
                       iff   time above mask >= 260 s (4.33 min)

USABLE FOR TELEMETRY   iff   time above mask >= 1 s  (one housekeeping frame)
```

A contact is **usable for receiving telemetry** if it is long enough to produce
at least one housekeeping frame. A contact is **usable for commanding** if what
is left after the overhead is at least the time one activity needs with a retry;
a contact leaving exactly that much is usable.

**The shortest contact, decided by the definition rather than by hand.** Contact 12 runs 80 s (1.33 min) above the mask. 80 s above the mask - 240 s overhead = -160 s usable; < 20 s needed. It cannot even complete acquisition and the close-out snapshot, let alone an activity between them, so it carries no commanding — and it is still usable for receiving telemetry, which is why D-014 has two tiers and not one threshold.

**A contact exactly on the boundary.** Contact 7 leaves 20 s usable against 20 s needed. The ruling says the margin must be *enough to complete* the activity with one retry; a contact leaving exactly that does leave enough, so it is usable. Treat it as usable for commanding, with no spare time: run the activity once, and if it needs the retry you will be at LOS.

## The passes

### PASS-1 — Nominal activation pass

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Procedure | `PROC-001` |
| Scenario | `sim/scenarios/P1_nominal.yaml` |
| Fault class | none |
| Contact | 13 — 450 s (7.50 min), commanding ALLOWED |
| Commanded | yes |

**How the anomaly is induced.** Nothing. P1_nominal carries no faults; this is the pass that establishes what normal looks like, and without it the three anomaly passes have no baseline to be abnormal against.

**Commanded activities.**

- Payload activation (CMD_PLD_SET_STATE ON) per PROC-001-S10, subject to the S08/S09 activation inhibit at 40 % state of charge.
- Payload sampling rate (CMD_PLD_SET_RATE) per PROC-001-S13.

**What the operator should observe.**

- CDH_FRAME_CNT advancing across consecutive frames, staleness annunciator GREEN.
- EPS_BATT_SOC above the 40 % activation inhibit at PROC-001-S08, so S09 takes the authorized branch.
- CDH_CMD_ACC_CNT incrementing by exactly one per command, PLD_STATE reading ON no later than the next housekeeping frame.
- No limit annunciation of any colour for the whole contact.

**Why this contact.** The longest contact in the week. A nominal pass carries the most commanding of the four, and the baseline is the one pass that should not be fighting the clock.

### PASS-2 — Array-string loss

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Procedure | `PROC-002` |
| Scenario | `sim/scenarios/P2_array_string_loss.yaml` |
| Fault class | HUG-EPS-004(a) — single array-string output forced to zero |
| Contact | 16 — 430 s (7.17 min), commanding ALLOWED |
| Commanded | no |
| FMEA | FM-EPS-01 |

**How the anomaly is induced.** By scenario file only, per HUG-SYS-005: P2_array_string_loss sets faults.strings_zeroed to string 1 at its scheduled time. No source change and no operator action induces it — the operator's job is to detect it, which is the whole point of the pass.

**What the operator should observe.**

- EPS_SA1_I collapsing to zero while EPS_SA2_I holds — the string ASYMMETRY that is FM-EPS-01's stated detection, and the reason the two strings are separately reported.
- EPS_BATT_SOC trending below the plan's predicted value, crossing the 35 % yellow limit if the contact runs long enough.
- PROC-001-S07 taking the limit-response branch, handing off to PROC-002 — which the pass report records under invoked_procedures.
- PROC-002's cause-discrimination steps distinguishing string loss from the other causes that present as low state of charge.

**Why this contact.** Long enough to watch a trend rather than take a single reading; not commanded, so it does not need the commanding margin.

### PASS-3 — Stuck-on load

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Procedure | `PROC-002` |
| Scenario | `sim/scenarios/P3_stuck_load.yaml` |
| Fault class | HUG-EPS-004(b) — stuck-on load of 2.0 W |
| Contact | 9 — 430 s (7.17 min), commanding ALLOWED |
| Commanded | yes |
| FMEA | FM-EPS-02 |

**How the anomaly is induced.** By scenario file only: P3_stuck_load sets faults.stuck_load, adding the dispositioned 2.0 W to the bus load. Again no operator action — inducing a fault by hand would make the pass a demonstration of the operator rather than of the detection path.

**Commanded activities.**

- A commanded load-shed response per PROC-002, if the mode ladder has not already acted. This is the pass that puts the command path on recorded data under an anomaly rather than under nominal conditions.

**What the operator should observe.**

- EPS_LOAD_I crossing its YELLOW limit BEFORE its RED — the dictionary's disposition ledger item 1 asserts this ordering, and this is where an operator sees it hold on live telemetry.
- EPS_BATT_SOC falling faster than the pass plan predicted.
- The commanded response accounted exactly once (CDH_CMD_ACC_CNT +1) with its effect visible in PLD_STATE or EPS_MODE by the next housekeeping frame.

**Why this contact.** Long enough to carry commanding under D-014 AND to show the yellow-before-red ordering, which needs the trend to develop inside the contact.

### PASS-4 — Housekeeping generation halt

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Procedure | `PROC-003` |
| Scenario | `sim/scenarios/P4_hk_generation_halt.yaml` |
| Fault class | HUG-EPS-004(c) — housekeeping telemetry generation halt, latched until CMD_SYS_RESET |
| Contact | 2 — 430 s (7.17 min), commanding ALLOWED |
| Commanded | yes |
| FMEA | FM-CDH-01 |

**How the anomaly is induced.** By scenario file only: P4_hk_generation_halt halts housekeeping frame generation at its scheduled time and LATCHES it. This is the same fault the B6 demonstration used, and the reason PROC-003 exists.

**Commanded activities.**

- CMD_SYS_RESET, which is the only thing that clears the latched halt. It is a hazardous command and takes the two-step confirmation of B7.

**What the operator should observe.**

- CDH_FRAME_CNT ceasing to advance while the interface stays CONNECTED — a halt on a live link, not a link drop.
- The staleness annunciator going YELLOW at 10 s and RED at 30 s of no advance, and NOT annunciating NO_READ or READ_FAULT, which would mean the ground segment is the problem rather than the spacecraft (D-012).
- PROC-003's branch selector distinguishing the spacecraft-side condition from the ground-side one and from a monitor read fault.
- After CMD_SYS_RESET, the post-reset counter epoch ACC = 1, REJ = 0 — the sole exception to delta arithmetic (HUG-CMD-005) — and CDH_FRAME_CNT advancing again.

**Why this contact.** Long enough for the 30 s RED threshold to be reached AND for a reset and its recovery to be observed afterwards, which is the longest sequence any pass in this campaign has to fit.
